title: Choose response fields
summary: Fastify: Choose response fields. Add pages to both the data and response schema.
introduction: A response schema can choose which fields are sent. GET /book keeps title and leaves out internalNote.
learningObjectives: Add pages to both the data and response schema

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Choose response fields

blocks.text: The response schema lists title only. Fastify serialises that public field and omits the note.
Add pages to both the data and response schema.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A response schema is not a replacement for deciding which data is safe to return.
